title: Tonkkatt
extract:
Tonkkatt are  Grineer mining tools that have been repurposed into Tonfas. The weapon gains temporary  Heat damage when increasing Melee Combo Multiplier.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matching  Sovereign Outcast.
Innate  polarity.
Increasing Combo Multiplier grants +4%  Heat damage for 15s. Stacks up to 30x.
 Heat damage does not combine with other elements.
Buff duration refreshes when gaining another stack.
All stacks are lost when the buff ends.

Acquisition
Tonkkatt's blueprint and components are dropped by Ghoul Expired and Ghoul Rictus that appear in the Plains of Eidolon, Ghoul Purge Bounties, and Disruption Olympus on Mars.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.
Acquisition Tip: Disruption mission on Olympus, Mars is rich with ghouls. Also, there is a chance that one of the conduits will be "Ghoul Eruption" which will make the mission more like a ghoul arena. If this conduit is not the last one of the round, it is advised to let it be destroyed and continue farming without finishing the round. A Nekros equipped with Slash weapons will increase the drop chance. Nekros' Despoil mod may help for energy problem. Also, Tak & Lug parts will drop during this farm.

Notes
Increasing the combo multiplier, e.g. going from 2x Combo to 3x Combo, will grant +4%  Heat damage for 15 seconds.
Buff stacks up to 30x, for a total of +120%  Heat damage.
 Heat damage will not combine with other elements.
Buff duration refreshes when gaining another stack.
All stacks are lost when the buff ends.
Reaching the maximum buff will require letting your combo multiplier expire or spent on Heavy Attack.

Tips
Initial Combo (e.g.  Corrupt Charge,  Galvanized Reflex) also counts as combo multiplier increase and thus grant 1 buff stack for each combo multiplier recovered from spending on Heavy Attack. This makes repeated Heavy Attacks an effective way of building and maintaining stacks.
 Melee Crescendo synergizes very well once it has been fully stacked, allowing the weapon to gain 44% heat damage after each heavy attack. This makes reaching and maintaining the maximum buff value trivially easy.
Heavy Attack Efficiency discounts the combo spent, therefore reduce the combo multiplier recovered and reduce or prevent the stack gains.
Tennokai eliminates the combo cost on Heavy Attack entirely, making this technique ineffective.

Trivia
Tonkkatt was first introduced in the Galleon of Ghouls Tactical Alert, available from the the first and third weeks (May 2nd to May 5th, 2025 and May 16th to May 19th, 2025). The first completion of the first Alert awarded the main blueprint, attached to an inbox message from Councilor Vay Hek, while every subsequent completion of the Alert awarded a random component.
